headline: Binance $6.3B heist, supermarket freezer attacks, and AI-driven cybercrime dominate
overview: The biggest story today is the roughly $6.3 billion Binance crypto theft, which Binance linked to a fake hiring process and a supply-chain compromise. Shows also covered freezer and refrigeration controllers being hacked across Europe and possibly at US military commissaries, and attackers using AI both to rank stolen victims and to run up cloud AI bills with stolen keys.
